entities.description: A young woman with shoulder-length black hair stands in a hallway, wearing a beige blazer over a black dress with a red and white floral pattern. She is wearing black lace-up combat boots and has one hand resting on the wall beside her.

attributes.position: center of frame, leaning slightly against wall

entities.description: A young Asian man with short black hair stands in a hallway, wearing a black suit jacket over a white button-down shirt and black trousers. He has his left arm extended with his hand pressed against the wall and his right arm around the shoulder of a woman standing next to him, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression.

attributes.pose: standing, left hand on wall, right arm around companion
